voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Sa salamin, puno ang dyip. Pero ikaw lang ang nakaupo.
lines.beat_before: hook: inside the jeep, the window across shows our bench full; beside her, empty

lines.text: Sa UP Diliman, may kuwento tungkol sa Ikot, ang dyip na umiikot sa kampus.
lines.beat_before: the campus at night: acacias, sodium lights, the Ikot in a puddle

lines.text: Gabi na. Isa-isang bumababa ang mga pasahero. At lahat sila, lumilingon sa iyo.
lines.beat_before: stop by stop, passengers get off, each looks back at her

lines.text: Bilangin mo ang barya sa upuan. Sobra ng isa.
lines.beat_before: the coins on the bench: one too many

lines.text: Sa huling hinto, hindi lumingon ang drayber. Mahina lang niyang sinabi,
lines.beat_before: alone: in the window, a grey figure beside her, its head bowed on her shoulder; the jeep stops

lines.text: pagdating mo, sunugin mo ang damit mo.
lines.beat_before: the driver from behind; he does not turn

lines.text: Alamat lang daw iyon. Pero buong biyahe raw, may nakakapit sa likod mo.
lines.beat_before: her room: the jacket comes off: two grey handprints on its back; then the can, the fire

lines.text: At umiikot pa rin ang Ikot.
lines.beat_before: the Ikot passes empty; in its window, her reflection, sitting
